items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER mentions Tito Rodriguez in the context of the Machito orchestra and billing issues, but the INTERVIEWEE does not mention Tito Rodriguez or describe any personal or professional interaction with him.

ctx.x: Okay. I agree with you because I like all three of you, but the Machito orchestra happened to be my sentimental favorite. But, you know, Tito Puente just overwhelmed me at that time and then there were things that Tito Rodruguez did that overwhelmed me, but the Machito band has been consistent since 1941 and, you know, this is something that never left my mind. So then it's your honest opinion that even though you gave in to Puente and Rodriguez on the billing issue, it never hurt you then.
No, no. It's just a matter of ----
